maya (AE): Riverfront wants a short perf POC next week: target p95 < 300ms, ~1k RPS single-turn. Can we do a quick load plan + cost range?

sam (SalesEng): Which model size?

lucas (Riverfront): We'll try 13B quantized first. Budget is limited; need defensible numbers.

priya (ML Eng): Proposal: two options.
- Option A (fast): 4 x A10G-like GPUs, continuous batching, concurrency target 48-64, warmup 30s, steady 8m, cooldown 2m.
- Option B (buffer): 8 GPUs for headroom.
We'll run k6 to drive requests and collect p50/p95/p99, req/sec, tokens/sec, GPU util, batch distribution, KV cache hit-rate.

chris (Infra): I'll reserve Dedicated sandbox for a 4-GPU run; can expand to 8 if needed. No VPC required for POC.

sam (SalesEng): Priya please paste the k6 command and the metrics we'll share in the SOW. Also need $/hr placeholders.

priya (ML Eng): k6 example: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m post-gen.js` where post-gen.js posts to `/v1/generate` with a single prompt. Metrics to report: p50/p95/p99, mean throughput, tokens/sec, GPU util, batch size histogram, KV hit-rate, error rate.

chris (Infra): Ballpark cost: A10G-equivalent ~$2.5/hr. 4 GPUs ~$10/hr, 8 GPUs ~$20/hr. Add ~ $5-10/hr for Dedicated overlay. Plan 4hr window + 6-8 engineer hours for prep/analysis.

maya (AE): Good. Lucas: will that range work for approval?

lucas (Riverfront): Yes, approve up to Option B for 4hr. Include runbook so we can observe dashboards.

priya (ML Eng): Brief runbook: set MODEL=llama-13b-q4o, run k6, monitor p95, GPU util, batch sizes, KV hit-rate. If p95 > 400ms for >2m, scale to 8 GPUs or change kernel. Collect summary.json and nvidia logs post-run.

deploy-bot: reservation created sandbox-dedicated-21 (4 gpus) id rsv-c3d2.

maya (AE): Thanks — Priya paste the small post-gen.js and env vars and I'll finalize the SOW and schedule Thursday.

sam (SalesEng): I'll also note security: public API key for POC; keys rotated afterwards.

lucas (Riverfront): Please add a short "leadership view": p95 latency, steady throughput, cost/1M requests, failure modes.

maya (AE): On it. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
